description: This file contains unit tests for the VoiceWakeGateway synchronization features, testing JSON decoding of trigger words in the VoiceWakePreferences module.

classes.name: VoiceWakeGatewaySyncTests
classes.description: A test suite containing multiple test cases for decoding gateway trigger words from JSON payloads.

methods.name: decodeGatewayTriggersFromJSONSanitizes
methods.description: Tests that the decoding function correctly sanitizes input by trimming whitespace and ignores empty strings, returning the expected list of triggers.

methods.name: decodeGatewayTriggersFromJSONFallsBackWhenEmpty
methods.description: Tests that the decoding function falls back to default trigger words when empty or whitespace-only triggers are provided.

methods.name: decodeGatewayTriggersFromInvalidJSONReturnsNil
methods.description: Ensures that invalid JSON input results in a nil response from the decoding function.
